verdict.rationale: The pricing page explicitly separates Lighthouse's service from government costs. It lists "Not included: USCIS filing fees, typically around $1-3k and varying by company size, and Premium Processing fees, around $3K", and backs this with a flat-price, no-surprise-fees promise and no extra charge for RFE responses. A cost-to-sponsor guide also offers a side-by-side budget comparison. Missing for 10: the evidence never shows Lighthouse's own dollar figures per case or tier, so the all-in total cannot be checked, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration that invoices match the published breakdown.
